title: Notification No. 13/2020-Central Tax (Base 500 Cr)
description: Initial e-invoicing turnover threshold set at 500 crore INR.

title: Notification No. 01/2022-Central Tax (20 Cr Limit)
description: E-invoicing aggregate turnover threshold reduced from 50 crore to 20 crore INR.

title: Notification No. 17/2022-Central Tax (10 Cr Limit)
description: E-invoicing aggregate turnover threshold reduced from 20 crore to 10 crore INR.

title: Circular No. 170/02/2022-GST (ITC Reversals)
description: Mandatory reporting of ineligible input tax credit under Section 16(4) and reversals.

title: Notification No. 10/2023-Central Tax (5 Cr Active Law)
description: E-invoicing aggregate turnover threshold reduced from 10 crore to 5 crore INR.

title: Notification No. 04/2024-Central Tax (30-Day IRP & 2FA)
description: Mandatory 30-day IRP reporting window rule and 2FA authentication for >= 10 Cr taxpayers.

title: Notification No. 25/2025-Central Tax (3 Cr Target Reform)
description: Proposed amendment reducing statutory e-invoicing threshold from 5 crore to 3 crore INR.

title: Notification No. 99/2026-Central Tax (2 Cr Future Target)
description: Synthetic amendment reducing turnover threshold from 5 crore to 2 crore INR for test cases.

title: Notification No. 01/2027-Central Tax (1 Cr Universal B2B)
description: Long-term roadmap notification extending mandatory e-invoicing to all B2B transactions >= 1 crore INR.
